outputs.explanation: Panel A is a deconvoluted native MS spectrum (a line/spectral plot with peak markers), not a bar chart of an average value across replicates. It shows raw relative-intensity data from a single spectrum, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.
Same as panel A: a raw native MS spectrum, not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data point overlay.

Bar chart showing the proportion (%) of protein population bound to specific numbers of metal atoms, derived from a single native MS spectrum deconvolution (as in A/B). There is no indication (e.g., error bars, 'mean') that these bars represent an average across independent replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Same type of single-measurement proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars or replicate averaging indicated.
Same type of single-measurement proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars or replicate averaging indicated.
Same type of single-measurement proportion bar chart as panel C, with no error bars or replicate averaging indicated.

Bar plot of chemical shift perturbation (CSP) per residue at three metal equivalents. Each bar represents a single measured CSP value per residue/condition (with stars marking peak broadening), not an average of multiple replicates, so no individual data points are required.
Same as panel G: single measured CSP values per residue/condition, not averaged replicate data, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
